animals.name: European Hedgehog
animals.summary: A nocturnal insect-eater that roams gardens, hedgerows and woodland edges at night. Numbers have fallen by more than 25% over the last decade, and possibly by as much as 40%.
animals.alt: A European hedgehog among grass and autumn leaves

animals.name: Red Squirrel
animals.summary: Britain's native squirrel, which feeds mainly on pine seeds and buries food in autumn for winter. Red squirrels have declined more than almost any other UK mammal, with about 287,000 left in Britain.
animals.alt: A red squirrel eating on a tree stump

animals.name: Barn Owl
animals.summary: A pale owl with a heart-shaped face and white underparts, often seen perched on fence posts or flying low over fields at dusk. It declined through the 20th century, partly because of pesticides such as DDT.
animals.alt: A barn owl perched on a wooden post

location.zone: Vine House Farm, Deeping St Nicholas, Spalding PE11 3DG

animals.name: Eurasian Otter
animals.summary: A river mammal that hunts mostly at night, eating fish, waterbirds and amphibians. Once in serious decline, otters have recovered well as waterways have become cleaner.
animals.alt: A Eurasian otter resting on a mossy rock

animals.name: European Badger
animals.summary: An omnivore that lives in large family groups in underground burrows called setts. It can eat several hundred earthworms in a night, and is one of the few predators of hedgehogs.
animals.habitat: Grassland, farmland, woodland and urban areas
animals.alt: A European badger at the edge of a woodland pool

location.zone: Cross Ln, Church Minshull, Nantwich CW5 6DY

animals.name: Kingfisher
animals.summary: A small, bright blue and orange bird that flies fast and low over the water and dives for fish from riverside perches. Its feathers contain no blue pigment: the colour comes from the way their tiny structures scatter light. Kingfishers are vulnerable to hard winters and polluted rivers.
animals.habitat: Slow-moving or still water: rivers, canals and lakes
animals.alt: A male kingfisher perched on a mossy stump

location.zone: Chew Valley Rd, Greenfield, Oldham OL3 7AE
